title: sole food 7
body:
i'm so hungry i could eat a mountain.
a big one.
like mount everest.
i mean if you really
 
think

about it
mount everest is an inverse snow cone.

imagine getting to the top
of mount everest just to see some
lanky, allegedly white-washed,
pringle-loving titan eyeing
your glorified alpine pedestal
like a teenager waiting for the coveted
travis scott meal at mcdonald's
after pushing the drive thru worker over
the limit with their tomfoolery.

too late to rappel
down to the bottom now blockhead.
